instruction: A candid outdoor photograph with a full shot of a scenic mountain lake during the day. On the left, the blonde woman in a grey hooded coat (R1) steps onto a large rock at the water's edge, her back partially turned. On the right, the bearded man in a brown fedora and denim jacket (R2) stands on the rock, facing her. They hold hands as he assists her step up, looking down at her with a warm smile. The background features a calm lake and snow-dusted rocky mountains under soft, overcast daylight, creating a cool, natural color palette.
